scripts.build: npm run build:functions && tsc -b && vite build && npm run check:precache
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-simply-fizzed "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions:integration: npm run build:functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-simply-fizzed "npm --prefix functions run test:integration"

allowScriptsNotes.@firebase/util: Denied: the app supplies Firebase web configuration at runtime and does not use App Hosting postinstall injection.
allowScriptsNotes.fsevents: Denied: this optional macOS watcher is not required for builds, tests, or non-watch development workflows.
allowScriptsNotes.protobufjs: Denied: the postinstall only warns about dependency version syntax and produces no required runtime artifacts.
allowScriptsNotes.re2: Denied: Superstatic treats the native binding as optional and falls back to JavaScript RegExp when it is unavailable.

auditNotes.GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf: No compatible override: @google-cloud/pubsub 5 requires @opentelemetry/core 1.x, while the fix is 2.8.0. Exposure is limited to the firebase-tools development CLI; retain Node.js default HTTP header limits and validate untrusted non-HTTP baggage until firebase-tools upgrades pubsub.
